site.description: Edit, convert and optimize images directly in your browser without uploading files to servers.
footer.createdWith: Fast, private image tools focused on the browser.
home.title: All your image tools in one simple website
home.description: Convert, resize, compress, rotate, flip, enhance and watermark images from the browser. FácilIMG is made for quick frontend-only image work without sending your files away.
tools.title: Included tools
tools.description: A frontend foundation that can grow like FácilPDF, but focused one hundred percent on images.
tools.convert.title: Convert formats
tools.convert.description: Export images as PNG, JPG or WebP with quality control.
tools.resize.title: Resize and optimize
tools.resize.description: Change width and height while keeping aspect ratio to reduce weight or prepare thumbnails.
tools.transform.title: Rotate and flip
tools.transform.description: Fix orientation, rotate ninety degrees or create mirrored versions in seconds.
tools.filters.title: Quick filters
tools.filters.description: Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, blur, grayscale or sepia.
tools.watermark.title: Watermark
tools.watermark.description: Add text on top of the image before downloading the result.
tools.front.title: Frontend only
tools.front.description: Everything runs with browser APIs and canvas, without remote processing.
editor.title: Upload an image and edit it instantly
editor.description: Pick a file, tune the output and download a new copy. The image is processed on your device.
editor.dropText: Supports PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG. Animated GIFs are processed as the first frame loaded by the browser.
editor.privacy: Your file is not uploaded to any server: the browser does the work with canvas.
how.title: How to use FácilIMG
how.one: Upload an image from your phone or computer.
how.two: Choose format, size, filters or watermark.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.private.q: Does the website upload my images?
faq.private.a: No. This first version works in the browser with canvas. There is no image processing server.
faq.mobile.a: Yes. The interface is mobile first and the controls adapt to small screens.
faq.batch.q: Can it process many images at once?
faq.batch.a: The base is ready to grow. This version includes single-image editing and can be expanded with batch processing.
